text: Team TNEV achieves a milestone as Commissioner Balasubramaniam approves testing their product, TNEV, at a signal junction near Government Hospital, Coimbatore. The Deputy Commissioner of Police, Traffic, and partners from Royal University, Analog and Digital Labs, and Uyir support the implementation. This collaboration highlights the potential of TNEV’s technology in enhancing emergency vehicle response and traffic management, marking a significant step toward a safer future. Stay tuned for updates on TNEV’s progress in this testing phase.
